UserHabitData.title: UserHabitData
UserHabitData.description: User account data storing habit categories, weekly completion checks, and discipline rank progression.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication user ID.

email.description: The email address associated with the user account.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

categories.description: List of active and archived habit categories configured by the user.

checks.description: Weekly checks matrix mapping weekKey -> categoryId -> day -> boolean.

bonusQualifyingWeeks.description: Total count of promotional bonus weeks recorded.

leaderboardSettings.description: User privacy settings and custom callsign for public leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest cloud synchronization.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public community leaderboard snapshot representing a warrior's discipline rank, qualifying weeks, and current week completion stats.

userId.description: The user ID of the competitor.

displayName.description: The warrior name or custom alias shown to others.

qualifyingWeeks.description: Number of qualifying discipline weeks earned.

weeklyCompletedChecks.description: Number of checks completed this week.

weeklyTargetChecks.description: Total target checks scheduled for this week.

topHabits.description: Summary list of user's active habit categories and their completion rates.

isPublic.description: Whether this entry is visible on the public leaderboard.

/users/{userId}.description: Isolated per-user document storing their personal categories, habit checks, and rank progress.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public warrior leaderboard snapshot allowing users to compare ranks, completion rates, and top categories.
